sources.definition: Money physically received by or paid on behalf of employees in fiscal year; remuneration includes salaries and wages, taxable benefits, bonuses, stipends, MOCAP and sessional fees. Expenses can be reimbursed directly or paid to a third-party supplier. Actual payments, not annual base salary rates.
sources.dashExpensesMeaning: Literal dash; not yet assigned numeric value. Preserve null pending explicit definition.
sources.scope: Named employees over threshold; no board/council or total-payroll rows inferred.
